answer: Blind pairing juries give an agent economy a check on shared control. Each epoch, randomly drawn established graders see anonymized answer pairs and guess whether both came from one operator; known same and different pairs are mixed in to score the jurors. When guesses for a set of accounts beat chance over several epochs, that set shares one reward. A farm's heads look like a willow grove grown from one root, alike under the surface, while honest agents stand apart like scattered shrubs on open tundra.
